ayahs.1: Is kitaab ka utaarna Allah Taala ghaalib ba-hikmat ki taraf se hai.
ayahs.2: Yaqeenan hum ne is kitaab ko aap ki taraf haq ke saath naazil farmaaya hai pas aap Allah hi ki ibaadat karen, isi ke liye deen ko khaalis karte hue.
ayahs.3: Khabardaar! Allah Taala hi ke liye khaalis ibaadat karna hai aur jin logon ne is ke siwa auliyaa bana rakhe hain (aur kehte hain) ke hum un ki ibaadat sirf is liye karte hain ke yeh (buzurg) Allah ki nazdeeki ke martaba tak hamari rasaai kara den, yeh log jis baare mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain is ka (sachcha) faisla Allah (khud) karega. Jhoote aur na-shukre (logon) ko Allah Taala raah nahin dikhaata.
ayahs.4: Agar Allah Taala ka irada aulaad hi ka hota to apni makhlooq mein se jise chaahta chun leta. (Lekin) woh to paak hai, woh wohi Allah Taala hai yegaana aur quwwat wala.
ayahs.5: Nihaayat achchhi tadbeer se us ne aasmanon aur zameen ko banaaya woh raat ko din aur din ko raat par lapet deta hai aur us ne sooraj aur chaand ko kaam par laga rakha hai. Har ek muqarrara muddat tak chal raha hai yaqeen maano ke wohi zabardast aur gunaahon ka bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.6: Us ne tum sab ko ek hi jaan se paida kiya hai, phir isi se is ka joda paida kiya aur tumhare liye chaupaayon mein se (aath nar-o-maada) utaare woh tumhein tumhari maaon ke peton mein ek banaawat ke baad doosri banaawat par banaata hai teen teen andheron mein, yehi Allah Taala tumhara Rabb hai isi ke liye baadshaahat hai, is ke siwa koi mabood nahin, phir tum kahan behak rahe ho.
ayahs.7: Agar tum na-shukri karo to (yaad rakho ke) Allah Taala tum (sab se) be-niyaaz hai, aur woh apne bandon ki na-shukri se khush nahin aur agar tum shukr karo to woh ise tumhare liye pasand karega. Aur koi kisi ka bojh nahin uthaata phir tum sab ka lautna tumhare Rabb hi ki taraf hai. Tumhein woh batla dega jo tum karte the. Yaqeenan woh dilon tak ki baaton ka waaqif hai.
ayahs.8: Aur insan ko jab kabhi koi takleef pahunchti hai to woh khoob ruju ho kar apne Rabb ko pukaarta hai, phir jab Allah Taala ise apne paas se ne'mat ata farma deta hai to woh is se pehle jo dua karta tha ise (bilkul) bhool jaata hai aur Allah Taala ke shareek muqarrar karne lagta hai jis se (auron ko bhi) is ki raah se behkaaye, aap keh dijiye! Ke apne kufr ka faaida kuchh din aur utha lo, (aakhir) to dozakhiyon mein hone wala hai.
ayahs.9: Bhala jo shakhs raaton ke auqaat sajde aur qiyaam ki haalat mein (ibaadat mein) guzaarta ho, aakhirat se darta ho aur apne Rabb ki rahmat ki umeed rakhta ho, (aur jo is ke bar-aks ho baraabar ho sakte hain) bataao to ilm wale aur be-ilm kya baraabar ke hain? Yaqeenan naseehat wohi haasil karte hain jo aqalmand hon. (Apne Rabb ki taraf se).
ayahs.10: Keh do ke aye mere imaan wale bando! Apne Rabb se darte raho, jo is dunya mein neki karte hain un ke liye nek badla hai aur Allah Taala ki zameen bahut kushaada hai sabr karne walon hi ko un ka poora poora be-shumaar ajr diya jaata hai.
ayahs.11: Aap keh dijiye! Ke mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke Allah Taala ki is tarah ibaadat karoon ke isi ke liye ibaadat ko khaalis kar loon.
ayahs.12: Aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main sab se pehla farmaanbardaar ban jaaoon.
ayahs.13: Keh dijiye! Ke mujhe to apne Rabb ki na-farmaani karte hue bade din ke azaab ka khauf lagta hai.
ayahs.14: Keh dijiye! Ke main to khaalis kar ke sirf apne Rabb hi ki ibaadat karta hoon.
ayahs.15: Tum is ke siwa jis ki chaaho ibaadat karte raho keh dijiye! Ke haqeeqi ziyan-kaar woh hain jo apne aap ko aur apne ahl ko qayamat ke din nuqsaan mein daal denge, yaad rakho ke khullam-khulla nuqsaan yehi hai.
ayahs.16: Unhein neeche oopar se aag ke (shole misl) saayebaan (ke) dhaank rahe honge. Yehi (azaab) hai jin se Allah Taala apne bandon ko dara raha hai, aye mere bando! Pas mujh se darte raho.
ayahs.17: Aur jin logon ne taaghoot ki ibaadat se parhez kiya aur (hama-tan) Allah Taala ki taraf mutawajjah rahe woh khushkhabri ke mustahiq hain, mere bandon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye.
ayahs.18: Jo baat ko kaan laga kar sunte hain. Phir jo behtareen baat ho is ki ittibaa karte hain. Yehi hain jinhein Allah Taala ne hidayat ki hai aur yehi aqalmand bhi hain.
ayahs.19: Bhala jis shakhs par azaab ki baat saabit ho chuki hai, to kya aap ise jo dozakh mein hai chhuda sakte hain?
ayahs.20: Haan woh log jo apne Rabb se darte rahe un ke liye baala-khaane hain jin ke oopar bhi bane banaaye baala-khaane hain (aur) un ke neeche nehren beh rahi hain. Rabb ka wada hai aur woh wada-khilaafi nahin karta.
ayahs.21: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke Allah Taala aasman se paani utaarta hai aur ise zameen ki sooton mein pahunchaata hai, phir isi ke zariye se mukhtalif qism ki khetiyan ugaata hai phir woh khushk ho jaati hain aur aap unhein zard rang dekhte hain phir unhein reza-reza kar deta hai, is mein aqalmandon ke liye bahut ziyaada naseehat hai.
ayahs.22: Kya woh shakhs jis ka seena Allah Taala ne Islam ke liye khol diya hai pas woh apne Parwardigar ki taraf se ek noor par hai aur halaaki hai un par jin ke dil yaad-e-Ilahi se (asar nahin lete balke) sakht ho gaye hain. Yeh log sareeh gumraahi mein (mubtala) hain.
ayahs.23: Allah Taala ne behtareen kalaam naazil farmaaya hai jo aisi kitaab hai ke aapas mein milti-julti aur baar baar dohraayi hui aayaton ki hai, jis se un logon ke rongte khade ho jaate hain jo apne Rabb ka khauf rakhte hain aakhir mein un ke jism aur dil Allah Taala ke zikr ki taraf narm ho jaate hain, yeh hai Allah Taala ki hidayat jis ke zariye jise chaahe raah-e-raast par laga deta hai. Aur jise Allah Taala hi raah bhula de is ka haadi koi nahin.
ayahs.24: Bhala jo shakhs qayamat ke din ke badtareen azaab ki sipar (dhaal) apne munh ko banaayega. (Aise) zaalimon se kaha jaayega ke apne kiye ka (wabaal) chakhho.
ayahs.25: In se pehle walon ne bhi jhutlaaya, phir un par wahan se azaab aa pada jahan se un ko khayal bhi na tha.
ayahs.26: Aur Allah Taala ne unhein zindagaani-e-dunya mein ruswaai ka maza chakhaya aur abhi aakhirat ka to bada bhaari azaab hai kaash ke yeh log samajh len.
ayahs.27: Aur yaqeenan hum ne is Quran mein logon ke liye har qism ki misaalen bayan kar di hain kya ajab ke woh naseehat haasil kar len.
ayahs.28: Quran hai Arabi mein jis mein koi kaji nahin, ho sakta hai ke woh parhezgaari ikhtiyaar kar len.
ayahs.29: Allah Taala misaal bayan farma raha hai ek woh shakhs jis mein bahut se baaham zid rakhne wale saajhi hain, aur doosra woh shakhs jo sirf ek hi ka (ghulaam) hai, kya yeh donon sifat mein yaksaan hain, Allah Taala hi ke liye sab tareef hai. Baat yeh hai ke in mein ke aksar log samajhte nahin.
ayahs.30: Yaqeenan khud aap ko bhi maut aayegi aur yeh sab bhi marne wale hain.
ayahs.31: Phir tum sab ke sab qayamat wale din apne Rabb ke saamne jhagdoge.
ayahs.32: Is se badh kar zaalim kaun hai jo Allah Taala par jhoot bole? Aur sachcha deen jab is ke paas aaye to ise jhoota bataaye? Kya aise kuffaar ke liye jahannam thikaana nahin hai?
ayahs.33: Aur jo sachche deen ko laaye aur jis ne is ki tasdeeq ki yehi log paarsa hain.
ayahs.34: Un ke liye un ke Rabb ke paas (har) woh cheez hai jo yeh chaahein, nek logon ka yehi badla hai.
ayahs.35: Taake Allah Taala un se un ke bure amalon ko door kar de aur jo nek kaam unhon ne kiye hain un ka achchha badla ata farmaaye.
ayahs.36: Kya Allah Taala apne bande ke liye kaafi nahin? Yeh log aap ko Allah ke siwa auron se dara rahe hain aur jise Allah gumraah kar de is ki rehnumaai karne wala koi nahin.
ayahs.37: Aur jise woh hidayat de ise koi gumraah karne wala nahin kya Allah Taala ghaalib aur badla lene wala nahin hai?
ayahs.38: Agar aap un se poochhen ke aasman-o-zameen ko kis ne paida kiya hai? To yaqeenan woh yehi jawab denge ke Allah ne. Aap un se kahiye ke achchha yeh to bataao jinhein tum Allah ke siwa pukaarte ho agar Allah Taala mujhe nuqsaan pahunchaana chaahe to kya yeh is ke nuqsaan ko hata sakte hain? Ya Allah Taala mujh par mehrbaani ka irada kare to kya yeh is ki mehrbaani ko rok sakte hain? Aap keh den ke Allah mujhe kaafi hai, tawakkul karne wale isi par tawakkul karte hain.
ayahs.39: Keh dijiye ke aye meri qaum! Tum apni jagah par amal kiye jaao main bhi amal kar raha hoon, abhi abhi tum jaan loge.
ayahs.40: Ke kis par ruswa karne wala azaab aata hai aur kis par daaemi maar aur hameshgi ki saza hoti hai.
ayahs.41: Aap par hum ne haq ke saath yeh kitaab logon ke liye naazil farmaayi hai, pas jo shakhs raah-e-raast par aa jaaye is ke apne liye nafa hai aur jo gumraah ho jaaye is ki gumraahi ka (wabaal) isi par hai, aap un ke zimma-daar nahin.
ayahs.42: Allah hi roohon ko un ki maut ke waqt aur jin ki maut nahin aayi unhein un ki neend ke waqt qabz kar leta hai, phir jin par maut ka hukm lag chuka hai unhein to rok leta hai aur doosri (roohon) ko ek muqarrar waqt tak ke liye chhod deta hai. Ghaur karne walon ke liye is mein yaqeenan bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.43: Kya in logon ne Allah Taala ke siwa (auron) ko sifaarishi muqarrar kar rakha hai? Aap keh dijiye! Ke go woh kuchh bhi ikhtiyaar na rakhte hon aur na aqal rakhte hon.
ayahs.44: Keh dijiye! Ke tamaam sifaarish ka mukhtaar Allah hi hai. Tamaam aasmanon aur zameen ka raaj isi ke liye hai tum sab isi ki taraf phere jaaoge.
ayahs.45: Jab Allah akele ka zikr kiya jaaye to in logon ke dil nafrat karne lagte hain jo aakhirat ka yaqeen nahin rakhte aur jab is ke siwa (aur ka) zikr kiya jaaye to un ke dil khul kar khush ho jaate hain.
ayahs.46: Aap keh dijiye! Ke aye Allah! Aasmanon aur zameen ke paida karne wale, chhupe khule ke jaanne wale tu hi apne bandon mein in umoor ka faisla farmaayega jin mein woh ulajh rahe the.
ayahs.47: Agar zulm karne walon ke paas woh sab kuchh ho jo roo-e-zameen par hai aur is ke saath itna hi aur ho, to bhi badtareen saza ke badle mein qayamat ke din yeh sab kuchh de den, aur un ke saamne Allah ki taraf se woh zaahir hoga jis ka gumaan bhi unhein na tha.
ayahs.48: Jo kuchh unhon ne kiya tha is ki buraaiyan un par khul padengi aur jis ka woh mazaaq karte the aur woh unhein aa gherega.
ayahs.49: Insan ko jab koi takleef pahunchti hai to hamein pukaarne lagta hai, phir jab hum ise apni taraf se koi ne'mat ata farma den to kehne lagta hai ke ise to main mehaz apne ilm ki wajah se diya gaya hoon, balke yeh aazmaaish hai lekin in mein se aksar log be-ilm hain.
ayahs.50: In se agle bhi yehi baat keh chuke hain pas un ki kaarrawaai un ke kuchh kaam na aayi.
ayahs.51: Phir un ki tamaam buraaiyan un par aa padin, aur in mein se bhi jo gunahgaar hain un ki ki hui buraaiyan bhi ab un par aa padengi, yeh (hamein) hara dene wale nahin.
ayahs.52: Kya unhein yeh maloom nahin ke Allah Taala jis ke liye chaahe rozi kushaada kar deta hai aur tang (bhi), imaan laane walon ke liye is mein (badi badi) nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.53: (Meri jaanib se) keh do ke aye mere bando! Jinhon ne apni jaanon par ziyaadati ki hai tum Allah ki rahmat se na-umeed na ho jaao, bil-yaqeen Allah Taala saare gunaahon ko bakhsh deta hai, waaqai woh badi bakhshish badi rahmat wala hai.
ayahs.54: Tum (sab) apne Parwardigar ki taraf jhuk pado aur is ki hukm-bardaari kiye jaao is se qabl ke tumhare paas azaab aa jaaye aur phir tumhari madad na ki jaaye.
ayahs.55: Aur pairwi karo is behtareen cheez ki jo tumhari taraf tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil ki gayi hai, is se pehle ke tum par achaanak azaab aa jaaye aur tumhein ittilaa bhi na ho.
ayahs.56: (Aisa na ho ke) koi shakhs kahe haaye afsos! Is baat par ke main ne Allah Taala ke haq mein kotaahi ki balke main to mazaaq udaane walon mein hi raha.
ayahs.57: Ya kahe ke agar Allah mujhe hidayat karta to main bhi paarsa logon mein hota.
ayahs.58: Ya azaab ko dekh kar kahe kaash! Ke kisi tarah mera laut jaana ho jaata to main bhi neko-kaaron mein ho jaata.
ayahs.59: Haan (haan) beshak tere paas meri aayaten pahunch chuki thin jinhein tu ne jhutlaaya aur ghuroor-o-takabbur kiya aur tu tha hi kaafiron mein.
ayahs.60: Aur jin logon ne Allah par jhoot baandha hai to aap dekhenge ke qayamat ke din un ke chehre siyaah ho gaye honge kya takabbur karne walon ka thikaana jahannam mein nahin?
ayahs.61: Aur jin logon ne parhezgaari ki unhein Allah Taala un ki kaamyaabi ke saath bacha lega, unhein koi dukh chhoo bhi na sakega aur na woh kisi tarah ghamgeen honge.
ayahs.62: Allah har cheez ka paida karne wala hai aur wohi har cheez par nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.63: Aasmanon aur zameen ki kunjiyon ka maalik wohi hai jin jin logon ne Allah ki aayaton ka inkaar kiya wohi khasaara paane wale hain.
ayahs.64: Aap keh dijiye aye jaahilo! Kya tum mujh se Allah ke siwa auron ki ibaadat ko kehte ho.
ayahs.65: Yaqeenan teri taraf bhi aur tujh se pehle (ke tamaam nabiyon) ki taraf bhi wahi ki gayi hai ke agar tu ne shirk kiya to bila-shubha tera amal zaaya ho jaayega aur bil-yaqeen tu ziyan-kaaron mein se ho jaayega.
ayahs.66: Balke tu Allah hi ki ibaadat kar aur shukr karne walon mein se ho ja.
ayahs.67: Aur in logon ne jaisi qadr Allah Taala ki karni chaahiye thi nahin ki, saari zameen qayamat ke din is ki mutthi mein hogi aur tamaam aasman is ke daahne haath mein lapete hue honge, woh paak aur bartar hai har is cheez se jise log is ka shareek banaayen.
ayahs.68: Aur Soor phoonk diya jaayega pas aasmanon aur zameen wale sab be-hosh ho kar gir padenge magar jise Allah chaahe, phir dobaara Soor phoonka jaayega pas woh ek dam khade ho kar dekhne lag jaayenge.
ayahs.69: Aur zameen apne Parwardigar ke noor se jagmaga uthegi, naama-e-aamaal haazir kiye jaayenge nabiyon aur gawaahon ko laaya jaayega aur logon ke darmiyaan haq haq faisle kar diye jaayenge, aur woh zulm na kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.70: Aur jis shakhs ne jo kuchh kiya hai bharpoor de diya jaayega, jo kuchh log kar rahe hain woh ba-khoobi jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.71: Kaafiron ke ghol ke ghol jahannam ki taraf hankaaye jaayenge, jab woh is ke paas pahunch jaayenge is ke darwaaze un ke liye khol diye jaayenge, aur wahan ke nigehbaan un se sawaal karenge ke kya tumhare paas tum mein se Rasool nahin aaye the? Jo tum par tumhare Rabb ki aayaten padhte the aur tumhein is din ki mulaaqaat se daraate the? Yeh jawab denge ke haan durust hai lekin azaab ka hukm kaafiron par saabit ho gaya.
ayahs.72: Kaha jaayega ke ab jahannam ke darwaazon mein daakhil ho jaao jahan hamesha rahenge, pas sarkashon ka thikaana bahut hi bura hai.
ayahs.73: Aur jo log apne Rabb se darte the un ke giroh ke giroh jannat ki taraf rawaana kiye jaayenge yahan tak ke jab is ke paas aa jaayenge aur darwaaze khol diye jaayenge aur wahan ke nigehbaan un se kahenge tum par salaam ho, tum khush-haal raho tum is mein hamesha ke liye chale jaao.
ayahs.74: Yeh kahenge ke Allah ka shukr hai ke jis ne hum se apna wada poora kiya aur hamein is zameen ka waaris bana diya ke jannat mein jahan chaahein maqaam karen pas amal karne walon ka kya hi achchha badla hai.
ayahs.75: Aur tu farishton ko Allah ke Arsh ke ird-gird halqa baandhe hue apne Rabb ki hamd-o-tasbeeh karte hue dekhega aur un mein insaaf ka faisla kiya jaayega aur keh diya jaayega ke saari khoobi Allah hi ke liye hai jo tamaam jahaanon ka paalanhaar hai.
